newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Stalexport closed higher and Universal lower while BRE and Budimex were flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday.
The remaining six stocks were untraded. Turnover was at 0.9 million zlotys, up from Wednesday's 0.4 million zlotys. NFI units rose in 14.6-million-zloty trade.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 10 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 70 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks fell and the main market's index dropped 2.7 percent.
